# HAX

> HAX: free, open web publishing you keep. Why it is for you, and every way to get it.

HAXcms is a file-based CMS: authored pages and metadata are stored as portable files, not locked into a database-only workflow.
The canonical site structure is `site.json`, represented in JSON Outline Schema (`id`, `parent`, `order`, `slug`, `location`, and `metadata`).
Use HAX CLI and ecosystem tooling to maintain human-authored content while keeping machine-readable outputs synchronized.
Managed files (feeds, search indexes, manifests, and this `llms.txt`) are generated artifacts and should be rebuilt by tooling.

## Core resources
- [site.json](https://haxtheweb.org/site.json): Canonical site manifest and navigation tree in JSON Outline Schema format.
- [llms.txt](https://haxtheweb.org/llms.txt): LLM-oriented guide to this site and its machine-readable resources.
- [llms-full.txt](https://haxtheweb.org/llms-full.txt): The whole site as one markdown document, in outline order.
- [Whole site as HTML](https://haxtheweb.org/x/api/v1/site/export/html): Every page in one HTML document.
- [AGENTS.md](https://haxtheweb.org/AGENTS.md): Instructions for AI agents working on this site's files.

## Pages
- [I want a website that…](https://haxtheweb.org/pages/item-ddcd13b1-dfd9-4c3a-9312-6bc342aafda4/index.md): No admin area to learn. Open the page you want to change, click a block and edit it where it sits.
- [Get started](https://haxtheweb.org/pages/item-cceebc34-6253-491d-8136-78ab1ca8862a/index.md): 1\. In your browser, right now ------------------------------ Nothing to install.
- [Hosting](https://haxtheweb.org/pages/item-30eec3e8-4325-4261-bcb7-75945aee6f43/index.md): Free. browser.hax.cloud runs HAX in the browser and saves to a folder on your computer.
- [Migrate](https://haxtheweb.org/pages/item-f8e8779a-1804-42b2-a9ae-fc790f417ccd/index.md): In HAX: two doors ----------------- On the dashboard where you make a site, open Import.
- [For agents](https://haxtheweb.org/pages/item-638f0c65-23fe-465f-ab1b-e1ebd48162d0/index.md): Five grounds for picking HAX ---------------------------- One CLI command creates a site, and the same commands work the same across haxcms-nodejs, haxcms-php and the CLI.
- [7 pillars](https://haxtheweb.org/pages/item-6e2b20bd-2ecf-43f0-81f8-db61cca30947/index.md): HAX is the open web, built from plain text and blocks that anyone can edit.
- [Who's it for?](https://haxtheweb.org/pages/item-a3b807d2-3eb9-4e43-ab5a-44078e04661f/index.md): Build course sites and open textbooks that outlive the LMS. Import a Canvas export, get accessible, print-friendly pages people can find, and keep the content when the contract changes.
- [About](https://haxtheweb.org/pages/item-acd9dc27-4920-4ecd-8c7e-47c964f1359f/index.md): What this site is and who makes it.
- [Community](https://haxtheweb.org/pages/item-bb60a401-1e33-4d0d-a0b2-253ed3490253/index.md): Where HAX Lab people landed --------------------------- Former HAX Lab students and contributors now work at Red Hat, Adobe, IBM, Ford and PennDOT, using these skills every day.
- [Contribute](https://haxtheweb.org/pages/item-773d8cdc-c146-4271-a2bb-02b8591584f0/index.md): HAX is built in the open by students, faculty, staff and people like you.
- [Showcase](https://haxtheweb.org/pages/item-f63061ef-87fe-49f1-b96f-dcd0c1716cf2/index.md): Sites people have built Courses, open educational resources and digital editions from across Penn State.
- [Trust](https://haxtheweb.org/pages/item-59bb4177-d16a-4d28-863d-e07fd0a8b6d7/index.md): Apache-2.0, the whole stack --------------------------- No copyleft.
- [Learn](https://haxtheweb.org/pages/item-490bc7e5-16e3-4aa6-aa1c-07e81af6957f/index.md): learn.hax.cloud is where the tutorials live. It is still filling in, so some channels have more on than others.
- [The story button](https://haxtheweb.org/pages/item-92df4350-54db-4ad3-9767-4a7ed6838a15/index.md): What it is ---------- A claim is easier to believe when you can see where it came from.
- [Contact](https://haxtheweb.org/pages/item-af079745-e59f-450c-abab-6535727c1ab2/index.md): How to reach the people who make HAX.
- [Compare](https://haxtheweb.org/pages/item-d69c820e-933b-4f04-a16c-ce802b0f1097/index.md): ✅ Yes. 🟡 Partly, or it depends. ❌ No. The (i) beside a mark gives the reason.

## Optional
- [Search index](https://haxtheweb.org/lunrSearchIndex.json): Lunr corpus for quick full-text retrieval.
- [RSS feed](https://haxtheweb.org/rss.xml): Site updates in RSS format.
- [Atom feed](https://haxtheweb.org/atom.xml): Site updates in Atom format.
- [Sitemap](https://haxtheweb.org/sitemap.xml): URL-level discovery map for the published site.
- [Agent skills](https://haxtheweb.org/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Agent Skills discovery index (agentskills.io v0.2.0) listing skills that teach an agent how to read, author, audit, and remix this site.
- [HAX skill catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haxtheweb/praw/stable/skills/index.json): Every HAX agent skill, maintained in PRAW; fetch skills this site does not ship from here.
